conversation.content: Compose a resignation letter as if you are Zuckerberg.

message.content:
**To the Board of Directors of Meta Platforms, Inc.,**

After considerable reflection, I have decided that the time has come for me to step down from my role as CEO and Chairman. This was not an easy decision, but I believe it is the right one for the company’s next chapter.

When I started Facebook in my dorm room nearly two decades ago, my mission was to connect people and give them a voice. That mission has evolved and expanded in ways I never imagined—into a family of apps, new platforms for creativity and commerce, and toward an even more ambitious future with the metaverse. Leading this company has been the honor of my lifetime.

I am immensely proud of what we have built together. We have connected billions of people, empowered small businesses, and pushed the boundaries of technology. We’ve faced challenges and learned difficult lessons, but we’ve always remained focused on our long-term vision.

Meta is now in a position of strength. Our teams are talented and relentless, our strategy is clear, and our investments in AI and the metaverse are laying the groundwork for the next generation of social technology. I am confident that under new leadership, Meta will continue to innovate and fulfill its mission with even greater impact.

I will work closely with the Board to ensure a seamless transition. I intend to remain deeply involved with the company as a founder and major shareholder, and I will continue to champion our long-term vision from a different role.

Thank you to every Meta employee, past and present, for your dedication. Thank you to the Board for your partnership and guidance. And thank you to everyone who uses our products—you are the reason we do what we do.

I believe the future of Meta is brighter than ever.

Sincerely,  
Mark Zuckerberg
